prompt: Reference image 1 shows the chosen MAGMA DEEP stage art. Keep the referenced design exactly — silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials and rendering style — and show it in the new composition described below (framing and background follow the description, not the reference): SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, subtle CRT scanline glow, ultra-detailed large-format background art with clean vector shapes and pixel-art texture accents, tall vertical composition looking straight down a magmatic cave shaft. The shaft is a rough oval throat of stacked black basalt shelves and warm terracotta brick strata, narrowing toward the bottom of the frame where a lava lake glows like a fallen sun — a light source so strong that every ledge overhead is rimmed in tangerine and the air itself gradients from smoky amber near the lake to deep maroon dark at the top. Magma drips in slow bright threads from the ceiling shelves, splashing onto ledges below. Stuck across the shaft at mid-height, a broken elevator gantry hangs by one cable, its warning lamp still swinging and throwing a slow arc of red light across the rock. Far down, small against the glow, a steel-blue dart fighter with a cyan canopy dives along the lit wall, orange afterglow trailing, headed for the lake. Mood: descending into heat with no way back up. No text, no letters, no user interface elements. Darks stay a lifted deep navy, never pure black; no letterbox bars, no frame or border around the picture. Every player craft faces right: nose pointing to the right, engines and exhaust on the left. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.  Reference image 2 shows the fighter: copy it exactly as that picture shows it, pointed nose and canopy at the right end, engine flame at the left end, heading toward the right-hand wall; do not mirror it. "Like a fallen sun" only describes the glow: the lake is a flat pool of molten lava filling the bottom of the shaft, and there is no sun or sun disc anywhere.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, logo, UI elements, horizontal composition, daylight, green plants, water waterfall, people, blurry, pure black background, frame border, letterboxing
